summary: Frontend-only retest executed for PDF export chapters bug. Login and book chapter rendering pass (2 chapter cards visible). Export button triggers chapter detail fetches, but Playwright could not capture popup event reliably in this environment, blocking full runtime validation of dedicated print window content.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking `book-export-pdf` did not emit Playwright `popup` event in repeated runs, preventing direct inspection of print window DOM during this test session.

integration_issues.flow: Login -> Livre romancé -> Export PDF popup capture
integration_issues.issue: Export flow appears to run (GET /api/book/chapters/{id} + GET /api/capsules seen in backend logs right after click), but popup handle was not captured by Playwright tool, so dedicated-window assertions could not be completed end-to-end.

action_items: Main agent should run/verify export flow with a desktop-oriented popup capture strategy (or tool setup) to conclusively validate popup DOM assertions.
Reconfirm runtime checks for: body[data-export-chapter-count], .chapter count == visible cards, chapter-content full text parity, and popup-only window.print target.
Keep current web fix logic unchanged until popup-capture retest is complete; static code review indicates intended fix path is present.
critical_code_review_comments: Static review confirms web branch opens popup synchronously before async chapter fetches (`openPrintPreviewWindow()` called before API requests).
Static review confirms empty-chapter guard exists and throws user-facing error (`Un chapitre est vide...`).
Static review confirms mobile branch still uses `Print.printToFileAsync({ html })` + `Sharing.shareAsync(...)` with same `html` built by `buildBookHtml`.
React warning still present in runtime logs: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` (non-blocking for this bug).
context_for_next_testing_agent: What passed: credential login (verification@racontelle.fr), navigation to Livre romancé, chapter cards visible (count=2), chapter read screen opens. What blocked: repeated inability to obtain popup handle from Playwright (`wait_for_event('popup')` timeout) even though backend logs show chapter detail and capsules calls immediately after clicking export.
rca_of_issue: Repro steps: login -> home-book-cta -> verify chapter cards -> click book-export-pdf -> Playwright popup wait times out. Observed signals: backend receives GET /api/book/chapters/{id} and /api/capsules after export click, so export logic likely executes. Probable RCA is testing-tool popup capture behavior in this environment (mobile viewport + RN web preview + window.open/print stubbing), not definitive functional regression in app code. Mitigation: rerun with desktop viewport and popup-capture-first instrumentation, or validate via in-app marker/telemetry emitted when print window document is written.
